regime: Rebound fading: tech futures slip and gold edges lower while the dollar holds a 20-month high on Fed hike bets
takeaway: Part of Monday's huge rally is being given back before the open: Nasdaq 100 futures are down about 1.8% as Nvidia slips, and gold miners are down about 1.7% in early trading while gold is off only about 0.3%, which matches the miners-lagging-gold pattern. Gold is still about 9% below a month ago, so the short-term downtrend check still applies. Traders see about a 96% chance of a December Fed hike, keeping the dollar near its 20-month high ahead of Wednesday's inflation report.
